NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
 Document ID
NT-HR-002
Department
Human Resources
Version
2.1
Effective Date
01 July 2025
1. Work Models
NovaTech follows a hybrid work model. Employees work from the office for 3 days per week
(Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday are the mandatory office days) and may work remotely on
Monday and Friday. Fully remote work is allowed only for roles approved by the Vice President of
the department.
2. Eligibility
Employees become eligible for hybrid work after completing their 3-month probation period.
Employees in their probation period must work from the office 5 days a week.
3. Work From Anywhere (WFA)
Each employee may work from a location other than their home city for up to 20 days per calendar
year under the Work From Anywhere programme. WFA must be inside India and requires manager
approval at least 7 days in advance. Working from another country is not allowed under this policy
because of tax and legal reasons.
4. Core Working Hours
Core hours are 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM India Standard Time. Employees must be available on chat
and video during core hours. Standard working hours are 8 hours per day, including a 1-hour lunch
break.
5. Home Office Allowance
Employees on the hybrid model receive a one-time home office setup allowance of Rs. 15,000 to
buy a chair, desk or monitor. In addition, a monthly internet reimbursement of up to Rs. 1,000 is
paid against a valid bill. The allowance can be claimed once every 3 years.
6. Equipment and Security
Company laptops must be used for all work. Employees must connect through the company VPN
when working remotely. Personal laptops are not permitted to access source code repositories.
